name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.72.1 — review-legs.js reads the LAST match of testCountPattern/skipReportPattern over runner output, never the first: a test name quoting the summary phrase precedes the real summary line, and a quoted zero forced a false red suite row on a green run (specs/20260903/02-whole-suite-review-leg.md close record). 7.72.0 — review gains a blocking `suite` leg closing the `scoped-gate-blind-spot` escape class (specs/20260903/02-whole-suite-review-leg.md): `review-legs.js` runs the host's bare `testCommand` once per legs iteration in its own wave (1b, between gate/reconcile/ci and at-risk/patterns), writing `suite-output.txt` and a row typed like the gate's; `verdict.js`'s `REVIEW_LEGS`/`REVIEW_BLOCKING` and the review driver's `BLOCKING_LEGS` require it in both scopes, red derives `GATE_RED` before any reviewer spend, and the driver's close-time re-run widens to the same bare command so files CLOSE itself writes are covered. `spec/doctrine/replay-corpus.md` gains the derived `scoped-gate-blind-spot` section (nine classes total) and `.claude/spec.config.json` declares it inapplicable now that the leg is mechanized here. tests/review/review-legs.test.js, tests/review/review-legs-smoke-wave.test.js, tests/review/legs-verdict-pair.test.js, tests/review/verdict.test.js, tests/verdict-gatered-no-workflow.test.js, tests/provenance/provenance.test.js, tests/review/escalate-row.test.js, tests/consistency/red-fixture-coverage.test.js, tests/review/review-driver.test.js, tests/replay/replay-corpus.test.js. 7.71.0 — genesis derives instead of guessing (specs/20260902/11-brief-from-approved-set.md): `.claude/genesis/brief.md` gains `## Journeys` (one block per seed journey — persona, the seed's surfaces block verbatim, per-screen `states:` lines) and `## Non-UI Coverage` (the six closed keys jobs/notifications/retention/integrations/admin/pricing) after `## Picks`; `--mark brief-written` refuses a missing seed journey, an unplaced label, or a `dark` non-UI key, and the BRIEF step text prints the confirmed product-row ids and journey/label counts it derives from. `roadmap-written` additionally requires every seed-declared label to land in exactly one brief's surfaces block, refusing unplaced or double-placed labels by name; the ROADMAP step text lists journeys → suggested brief slices. `skeleton-landed` requires the shell canon authored from the seed's densest composed screen and extracted onto every mock via `design-atlas.js shell adopt --apply`, plus a components manifest covering every canon primitive. The MENUS step prints the seed's `primary-surface` and `platforms-horizon` rows above the framework dimension so the pick is priced against them. `spec-status.js` renders a read-only `🧭 misunderstandings: {N} caught before build (latest {id} at {step})` line under 🗺️ Roadmap from `design/mocks/ledger.md`; `--json` shapes unchanged. tests/genesis/brief-state.test.js, tests/genesis/genesis-driver.test.js, tests/spec-status.test.js, tests/consistency/genesis-doctrine.test.js.
